nodes.summary: The arithmetic of infinite cardinals, including the continuum hypothesis and the singular cardinals hypothesis, together with cardinal invariants of the continuum and the cofinal structure of directed sets.
nodes.title: Cardinal arithmetic and cardinal characteristics

nodes.summary: The forcing method and the axioms that assert the existence of generic filters, such as Martin's axiom and the proper forcing axiom, together with combinatorial dichotomies like the open coloring axiom and the P-ideal dichotomy that follow from them.
nodes.title: Forcing and forcing axioms

nodes.summary: Combinatorics of infinite and uncountable sets: clubs and stationary sets, partition relations, Δ-systems, almost disjoint families, combinatorial principles such as diamond and square, set-theoretic trees, Ramsey ultrafilters and the structure of P(ω)/fin.
nodes.title: Infinitary combinatorics

nodes.summary: Cardinals with strong closure or reflection properties, such as inaccessible, Mahlo, weakly compact and measurable cardinals, whose existence cannot be proved in ZFC.
nodes.title: Large cardinals

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
